name: The Angel Of Light
overview: Scripture reveals a spiritual conflict involving fallen angels who have rebelled against God and are reserved for judgment, as seen in Jude 1:6. Satan, described as the adversary, appears among the sons of God presenting himself before the LORD (Job 1:6), and is associated with the rulers of darkness and spiritual wickedness in high places (Ephesians 6:12). In contrast, Jesus proclaims Himself as the true light of the world, offering life and guidance away from darkness (John 8:12), highlighting the deceptive nature of those who masquerade as beings of light while opposing God's truth.
